proof: The unchanged exact h=exp(-8002*(exp(1048576)+10)) satisfies0<h<1. rho=h/256 is strictly positive.
On0<u<1, sigma_prime>0 and its total mass is1. Since0<1-h<1 and1<=1+2u<=3, the integral I satisfies1<I<exp(3).

The elementary factorial series gives e=2+sum_{n>=2}1/n!<2+sum_{n>=2}1/2^(n-1)=3, since n!>=2^(n-1) with a strict inequality for n>=3. Thus exp(3)=e^3<27 without floating-point transcendental comparison.
Positivity permits reciprocal reversal:85/9<1/K=h/Qp<256. The symbolic unscaled relation is h/256<Qp<(9/85)*h; no decimal h or Qp value is constructed.
The two square seeds interchange under u->1-u, proving sigma(1-u)=1-sigma(u). Integration gives S(1)=1/2. Subtract the integral on[1-x,1] and use that same symmetry to get S(1-x)=S(x)+1/2-x.
